about_short_description.short_description: A financial super-app that empowers you with a versatile financial account simplifying all your money.

product.name: Current or Savings Account
product.description: A digital bank account with no minimum balance requirement that supports multiple transactions including bill payments, mobile top-ups, and fund transfers.

product.name: Home Remittance Account
product.description: An account to receive international money transfers directly with cashback rewards on every transfer.

product.name: Peer-to-Peer Transfers
product.description: A service to instantly send money to friends using their mobile number or contacts securely and without hassle.

product.name: Bill Payments
product.description: A platform feature to pay utility bills such as electricity, gas, water, and telecom services quickly and set reminders to avoid missed payments.

product.name: Free Mastercard Debit Card
product.description: A debit card linked to the Jingle Pay account that offers cashback on transactions and a joining bonus.

identifier.value: Bill Splitting and Money Request Features

product.name: Bill Splitting and Money Request Features
product.description: Tools to split bills among friends and request money easily using mobile contacts within the app.
